name: Ahmed ibn Abi Mahalli
contribution: A Moroccan Imam and the Sufi leader of a revolt against the reigning Saadi Sultan Zidan Abu Maali in the south of Morocco in which Ibn Abi Mahalli proclaimed himself Mahdi.

checks.lead: Ahmed ibn Abi Mahalli (Arabic: ابن أبي محلي; 1560–1613), born in Sijilmasa, was a Moroccan Imam and the Sufi leader of a revolt (1610–13) against the reigning Saadi Sultan Zidan Abu Maali in the south of Morocco in which Ibn Abi Mahalli proclaimed himself Mahdi. He occupied the Saadi's southern capital Marrakesh in 1612 until his death.
